title: Notary Project Plugin Protocol
description: JSON Schema for the Notation plugin extensibility protocol. Notation plugins are executables that implement external key management and signing capabilities. Notation invokes plugins by passing a JSON request on stdin and reading the JSON response from stdout. Plugins must implement the get-plugin-metadata command and optionally implement signing (describe-key, generate-signature) and/or verification (generate-envelope, verify-signature) capability commands.

GetPluginMetadataRequest.description: Request payload for the get-plugin-metadata command. Notation sends this to discover what capabilities and contract versions the plugin supports.

contractVersion.description: The plugin contract version that Notation supports. The plugin should verify it supports this version.

GetPluginMetadataResponse.description: Response payload for the get-plugin-metadata command containing plugin identification and supported capabilities.

name.description: Name of the plugin. Must match the plugin binary name suffix after 'notation-'.

description.description: Human-readable description of the plugin and what key management or signing service it integrates with.

version.description: Semantic version of the plugin following the SemVer 2.0 specification (e.g., 1.0.0).

url.description: URL of the plugin's documentation, homepage, or source repository.

supportedContractVersions.description: List of plugin contract versions this plugin supports. Must include at least one version.

capabilities.description: List of capabilities the plugin implements. Each capability requires implementing a specific set of commands. SIGNATURE_GENERATOR.RAW requires describe-key and generate-signature. SIGNATURE_VERIFIER.TRUSTED_IDENTITY and SIGNATURE_VERIFIER.REVOCATION_CHECK require verify-signature.

DescribeKeyRequest.description: Request payload for the describe-key command. Notation sends this to learn the key specification (algorithm and size) for a given key ID so it can select the appropriate signature algorithm.

contractVersion.description: The plugin contract version being used for this invocation.

keyId.description: Plugin-specific identifier for the signing key. This is the value from the signing key configuration in Notation's keys.json.

pluginConfig.description: Optional plugin-specific configuration key-value pairs passed from the signing key configuration.

DescribeKeyResponse.description: Response payload for the describe-key command containing the key specification for the requested key.

keyId.description: The key ID echoed from the request, confirming which key is being described.

keySpec.description: The key specification string identifying the key algorithm and size. Used by Notation to select the hash algorithm for signature generation.

GenerateSignatureRequest.description: Request payload for the generate-signature command. Notation sends the payload to be signed (the signature envelope payload bytes) and the plugin returns the raw signature bytes signed with the specified key.

contractVersion.description: The plugin contract version being used.

keyId.description: Plugin-specific identifier for the signing key to use.

keySpec.description: Key specification of the signing key as returned by describe-key.

hashAlgorithm.description: Hash algorithm to use when generating the signature. Must be compatible with the key spec.

payload.description: Base64-encoded bytes of the data to be signed. This is the signature envelope payload as determined by Notation based on the signing algorithm.

GenerateSignatureResponse.description: Response payload for the generate-signature command containing the raw signature and certificate chain.

keyId.description: The key ID echoed from the request.

signature.description: Base64-encoded raw signature bytes produced by signing the request payload with the specified key.

signingAlgorithm.description: The signing algorithm used, expressed as a fully-qualified algorithm string matching the Notary Project signature specification.

certificateChain.description: Ordered array of base64-encoded DER-format X.509 certificates forming the signing certificate chain. The first certificate is the leaf signing certificate; subsequent certificates are intermediates and the root CA.

VerifySignatureRequest.description: Request payload for the verify-signature command sent to plugins that implement SIGNATURE_VERIFIER capabilities. Notation sends this for trusted identity validation and revocation checking.

contractVersion.description: The plugin contract version being used.

criticalAttributes.description: Critical signed attributes from the signature envelope header.

contentType.description: Content type of the signature payload.

signingTime.description: The time at which the signature was created.

expiry.description: Optional expiry time after which the signature is no longer valid.

unprocessedAttributes.description: Signed attributes not processed by Notation, passed to the plugin for validation.

certificateChain.description: Certificate chain from the signature envelope for revocation checking.

trustPolicy.description: The trust policy statement that matched this artifact, providing the plugin with policy context.

trustedIdentities.description: List of trusted identity patterns from the matching trust policy statement.

items.description: A trusted identity string (e.g., x509.subject: CN=...).

signatureVerification.description: Signature verification configuration from the trust policy.

VerifySignatureResponse.description: Response payload for the verify-signature command indicating which verifications the plugin performed and their outcomes.

verificationResults.description: Map of verification type to verification result. Each key is a capability type the plugin verified.

processedAttributes.description: List of attribute names from unprocessedAttributes that the plugin consumed during verification.

items.description: An attribute name that was processed by the plugin.

VerificationResult.description: The result of a single verification check performed by the plugin.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the verification result, especially on failure.

PluginErrorResponse.description: Error response written to stderr when a plugin command fails. The plugin exits with a non-zero exit code and writes this JSON to stderr.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code identifying the type of failure.

errorMessage.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.
